overview: Suriname is the smallest country in South America. Its capital and largest city is Paramaribo. Suriname was a Dutch colony until 1975, and it is the only country in South America where Dutch is the official language. Its people have roots in many places, including Africa, India, Indonesia, China and Europe, as well as Indigenous peoples.

geography.text: Most people live along the narrow coastal plain. The rest of Suriname is covered by dense tropical rainforest, making it one of the most forested countries in the world, crossed by rivers flowing north to the Atlantic. The Brokopondo Reservoir, created by a dam in the 1960s, is one of the largest reservoirs in the world.
